profile.headline: Web Development and Digital Strategy
profile.summary:
At the intersection of high-level engineering and radical empathy, I help e-commerce brands reclaim their peace of mind. In an era of cold, faceless technology, I believe that your business deserves more than just code. It deserves a Digital Sanctuary. I build secure, high-performing e-commerce systems that protect your data and help to market your business with digital ad management to best optimize your growth, allowing you to focus on the human side of your work and spend more time with the people you love.

My approach is rooted in the belief that integrity is the only sustainable infrastructure. Whether I’m engineering custom Google Ads scripts to eliminate waste or auditing a site for security vulnerabilities, I bring a unique blend of technical grit and compassionate understanding to every project.

◖My Core Pillars:◗

» Integrity-First Engineering: I treat your data and budget with the reverence they deserve, ensuring every project is ethical, transparent, and built to last.

» Grit-Powered Problem-Solving: Challenges are simply opportunities for leaping over the competition. I bring a relentless spirit to solving complex tech problems so that you can find rest. 

» The Human Touch: I lead with softness and deep listening. Building the perfect "Digital Sanctuary" for your business isn't just about clicks and sales, it's about honouring the people behind the screen and building true connection.

Success isn't just about the numbers; it's about the drive to build something meaningful. Let’s transform your digital presence into a secure, thriving space that reflects the heart of your mission.

positions.title: Operations Manager
positions.description:
•	Strategized and implemented digital strategy that had seen the company grow in the double-digits year-over-year. 
•	Raised revenues 10% in 2015 while maintaining less than 2% increase in total advertising budget across pay-per-click in Google AdWords and Bing.
•	Recovered 25% of total advertising budget by forming cooperative partnerships with key vendors.
•	Manage company e-commerce website with over 200,000 products utilizing knowledge in Magento, HTML, CSS3, PHP, MySQL, Apache and nginx.
•	Planned and implemented SEO initiative that boosted traffic by 30% between 2013 and 2014.
•	Implemented changes that increased overall website traffic ~560% between 2009 and 2015.
•	Manage several Windows-based computers and peripheral devices performing tasks such as installing software, updating software, and troubleshooting.

positions.title: Lead Administrator
positions.description:
•	Managed active community of more than 12,500 users on custom Invision Power Board forums.
•	Created custom new website using Wordpress-based Content Management System.
•	Managed virtual staff of 25 people.
•	Managed Linux-based Virtual Private Server utilizing skills in PHP, MySQL, Postfix, Apache, Bind DNS.
•	Created promotions and contests to increase traffic and user participation.

I acquired Stellar Dawn Central in September 2008. At the time the website was not fully developed and the traffic lagged behind all websites of its kind. Within a year the website had grown over 1,100% and was now the de facto leader of Stellar Dawn fan sites. Average unique visitors in 2009 totaled ~1,159/day, with a peak of ~4,600/day unique visitors in mid February.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
•	Created web designs, logos, advertisements and other graphic designs using Adobe Fireworks and Adobe Photoshop.
              •	Coded static website layouts utilizing HTML and CSS.
              •	Managed day-to-day operations, including invoicing, sales and customer service.

projects.title: Art Support Initiative
projects.description: Create contests to support the arts. Utilized my own gallery and journal on the popular art platform DeviantArt for promotion. Over the course of 2013 and 2014, tens of thousands of people participated in the contests, leading to hundreds of thousands of unique views. Boosted measurable engagement at least 1500% from 2012. Currently over 2,000 followers on DeviantArt and growing.
